people.name: Margaret Wilson
people.about: A retired teacher, garden enthusiast and proud grandmother. Please call me Maggie.
people.preferences: Tea with milk, a quiet morning and a walk in the garden after lunch.

people.name: Arthur Bennett
people.about: Former engineer who loves jazz, crosswords and sharing stories.
people.preferences: Coffee at breakfast. I like choosing my own clothes and activities.

people.name: Evelyn Clarke
people.about: An accomplished baker who enjoys music and time with her family.
people.preferences: Small meals, familiar music and a seat near the window.

people.name: George Patel
people.about: A cricket fan and keen reader who enjoys conversation over tea.
people.preferences: Vegetarian meals and time to read the newspaper in the morning.

people.name: Rose Thompson
people.about: Loves painting, old films and visits from her grandchildren.
people.preferences: Art group on Fridays and a relaxed evening routine.

people.name: Henry Williams
people.about: Enjoys gardening, football and keeping in touch with friends.
people.preferences: An early breakfast and a short walk with company.

plans.title: Moving with confidence
plans.goal: Enjoy a supported walk in the garden each day.
plans.actions: Offer a choice of walking times. Follow the agreed mobility assessment and record comfort after each walk.

plans.title: Making mealtimes enjoyable
plans.goal: Feel comfortable and supported at mealtimes.
plans.actions: Offer preferred small meals. Record preferences and escalate changes in appetite to the care lead.

plans.title: My day, my choices
plans.goal: Choose and participate in two meaningful activities each week.
plans.actions: Share the activity calendar and support Arthur to make his own choices.

plans.title: A familiar daily routine
plans.goal: Maintain a comfortable routine with preferred support.
plans.actions: Ask about preferences before each activity and encourage participation.

plans.title: Time for creativity
plans.goal: Join a creative activity twice a week.
plans.actions: Offer painting and music sessions and record how Rose feels afterwards.

plans.title: Keeping connected
plans.goal: Enjoy regular social time and garden visits.
plans.actions: Offer a daily opportunity for social time and support contact with friends.

notes.text: Evelyn preferred a smaller breakfast today. Please offer her usual choices at lunch and record how she feels.
notes.author: Amelia Ross

notes.text: Arthur enjoyed the morning crossword group and would like to attend again next week.
notes.author: Oliver James

notes.text: Emma visited this morning. Maggie is looking forward to their garden walk this weekend.
notes.author: Sarah Chen
